messages:
Priya Nair: FYI saw a canary flip this morning for the AWQ rollout on pool-12 during regen load test. Opening thread to collect quick notes and next steps.
Jamal Ortiz: Which signal? error spikes, perf, or quality?
Priya Nair: Deploy bot summary: quality_delta exceeded gate + some decode errors. Short log:
```:log
[2026-03-05T09:12:03Z] decode_error: detokenized_length_mismatch (expected 42, got 38)
[2026-03-05T09:12:03Z] sample_ppl: 23.4 -> 24.9 (+1.5)
[2026-03-05T09:12:03Z] kv_cache_evictions: 6
```
bench-bot: Canary 2026-03-05T09:10 -> fail on policy: quality_delta > 1.0% (gating)
Marta Lopez: Did the canary include any quant config changes vs stable?
Priya Nair: Yes. Canary had AWQ with activation quantization enabled and group_size reduced to 32 to try to cut tail latency. Config excerpt:
```:yaml
model: redwood/bison-13b
quant: awq
act_quant: true
group_size: 32
symmetric: false
calibration_steps: 256
kv_cache_policy: dynamic
```
Alex Chen: group_size=32 + act_quant=true is a known risky combo for some models. Smaller groups change accumulation order which can amplify quantization noise.
Samira Patel: I pulled the staging AB results. Very quick summary:
- stable (gs=128, act=false): baseline
- variant A (gs=64, act=true): ~0.7% EM drop
- variant B (gs=32, act=true): ~2.3% EM drop + intermittent decode length mismatch
Also saw KV eviction warnings in the runtime traces around token ~512 for a subset of long-context requests.
Jamal Ortiz: Hypothesis: reduced group_size increases how often micro-batching flushes, changing activation accumulation and rounding ties. With act_quant enabled those rounding errors can push logits across tokenization boundaries -> detokenized length mismatches. KV evictions may compound by causing cache misses mid-decode.
Marta Lopez: Can someone reproduce locally with the exact canary config? I want to run a sweep matrix (group_size x act_quant) and capture decode-length, ppl, and top-k drift.
Priya Nair: I'm attaching a quick repro plan in the ML ticket ML-5423 (internal): run 200-sample smoke eval with seeds and repeat each config 3x, capture per-sample token-by-token logits and decode length.
Alex Chen: Mitigations we pushed this morning:
- rolled canary back to stable (gs=128, act_quant=false) 
- rollback applied by deploy-bot: rollback -> stable@rev-1221 :white_check_mark:
Short term options: re-enable gs=128, disable act_quant, or increase calibration_steps to 1024. Also can pre-warm KV cache to avoid eviction.
Samira Patel: I'll add a lightweight CI check to rollout that runs 10 long-context decodes and asserts decode length == expected and ppl delta < 0.5. Also instrument per-request kv_eviction counts in APM.
Marta Lopez: I'll own a formal sweep. Proposed matrix: group_size in [32,64,128,256], act_quant in [true,false], calibration_steps in [256,1024]. We'll compare vs GPTQ baseline too. Schedule Tue 15:00 to run distributed jobs.
Jamal Ortiz: If GPTQ shows similar deltas it's likely calibration/rounding sensitivity rather than AWQ-specific. If only AWQ fails, may need to adjust act quant algorithm or add stochastic calibration.
Priya Nair: Added notes: observed one example where sampling produced truncated output (length mismatch) only under gs=32/act=true; same seed produced correct-length output under baseline. Saved full token logits and kv events to ML-5423 artifacts.
Alex Chen: Two quick experiments to prioritize: 1) rerun that failing seed with per-batch calibration (vs static 256 steps) 2) run gs=32 with act_quant=true but force deterministic accumulation order (if supported) to isolate ordering effect.
Samira Patel: I'll add the per-request kv eviction counter + tag alerts when evictions > 0 for a decode. That should help triage in production if this recurs.
Priya Nair: Thanks. Keeping this thread as the source of truth. I'll update ML-5423 with sweep schedule and attach notebook link once ready. Tagging @eng-oncall in case this crops up again. :thumbsup:
